name: forge
description: Sixty command-invoked toolkits in one plugin, covering WordPress engineering, design and accessibility, long-form writing, DevOps and data, cloud and architecture, security, code cleanup, and documentation and diagrams. Every toolkit is reached through an explicit slash command - nothing auto-triggers, so none of these procedures can fire on their own or collide with other installed skills. Each command loads its own procedure file from lib/<name>/SKILL.md on invocation and pulls bundled references, scripts, and assets from the same folder. Run /forge for a category-then-item picker across the whole catalog, or jump to one category with /forge-wordpress, /forge-design, /forge-writing, /forge-devops, /forge-cloud, /forge-security, /forge-cleanup, /forge-docs, /forge-utils, or call any tool directly: /wp-plugin, /wp-build, /wp-theme, /wp-review, /wp-consult, /wp-format, /wp-menu-icons, /wp-report-card, /wp-grade, /wp-performance, /html-design-styles, /accessibility-audit, /design-system, /tailwind-convert, /page-cloner, /page-tailwindify, /tech-blog-article, /tutorial-builder, /language-tutor, /draft-contract, /name-domains, /docker-compose-architect, /kubernetes-architect, /powershell-script-engine, /jq, /explain-sql, /system-design, /terraform, /cicd-pipeline, /data-pipeline, /cloud-migration, /sre-audit, /finops, /incident-report, /threat-model, /devsecops, /pentest-report, /unslop, /strip-unicode, /strip-emoji, /strip-comments, /docblock-rewrite, /refactor, /explain-my-code, /code-teacher, /codebase-to-mermaid, /mermaid-to-ascii, /mermaid-sequence, /readme-builder, /changelog-generator, /explain-prompt, /analyze-prompt, /rank-prompt, /prompt-rank-table, /prompt-stencil, /blueprint, /session-stats, /vgademo, /fix-formula, /crash-report.
